SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  total_synsets,
  total_senses,
  distinct_domains,
  distinct_posids,
  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   GROUP BY s.synsetid 
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC 
   LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 
                     WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid 
                     GROUP BY s2.synsetid 
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC 
                     LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2 
    AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY
  total_senses DESC,
  total_synsets DESC,
  distinct_domains DESC,
  word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;--- SCHEMA ---

cd /app && cat > sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
),
sel AS (
  SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC LIMIT 500
),
ws AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM senses s WHERE s.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM sel) GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT wordid, synsetid, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY c DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn FROM ws
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT sel.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word, sel.total_synsets, sel.total_senses,
       sel.distinct_domains, sel.distinct_posids, top.synsetid AS top_synsetid, top.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM sel JOIN words w ON w.wordid = sel.wordid JOIN top ON top.wordid = sel.wordid
ORDER BY sel.total_senses DESC, sel.total_synsets DESC, sel.distinct_domains DESC, sel.wordid ASC;
EOF
test -s sol.sql && echo DRAFT_OK; sqlite3 --version; echo '--- indexes ---'; sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT type,name,tbl_name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('index','table') AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type,name;" | head -60; echo '--- orphan senses ---'; sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM synsets y WHERE y.synsetid=s.synsetid);"; echo '--- synset dup ---'; sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets;"

cd /app && cat > sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ws(wordid, synsetid, c, domainid, posid) AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*), syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON s.wordid = w.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
agg AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(c) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND SUM(c) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
),
top500 AS (
  SELECT wordid, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids
  FROM agg
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT ws.wordid AS wordid, ws.synsetid AS synsetid, ws.c AS c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.wordid ORDER BY ws.c DESC, ws.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM ws JOIN top500 t ON t.wordid = ws.wordid
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT t.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word, t.total_synsets, t.total_senses,
       t.distinct_domains, t.distinct_posids, top.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       top.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM top500 t
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = t.wordid
JOIN top ON top.wordid = t.wordid
ORDER BY t.total_senses DESC, t.total_synsets DESC, t.distinct_domains DESC, t.wordid ASC;
EOF
test -s sol.sql && echo DRAFT_OK; cp /app/oewn.sqlite /tmp/ref.sqlite && sqlite3 /tmp/ref.sqlite "CREATE INDEX i_w ON words(wordid); CREATE INDEX i_s_w ON senses(wordid); CREATE INDEX i_s_y ON senses(synsetid); CREATE INDEX i_y ON synsets(synsetid);" && echo IDX_OK; time sqlite3 /tmp/ref.sqlite < /app/my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/ref.out; wc -l /tmp/ref.out; head -3 /tmp/ref.out

cd /app && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/sol.out; echo "rc=$?"; wc -l /tmp/sol.out; head -3 /tmp/sol.out; echo '--- diff ---'; diff /tmp/ref.out /tmp/sol.out > /tmp/d.txt; echo "diff_rc=$?"; head -10 /tmp/d.txt
test -s /app/sol.sql && { printf 'EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN '; cat /app/sol.sql; } | sqlite3 -readonly /app/oewn.sqlite >/dev/null

cd /app && echo '--- sol.sql ---' && cat sol.sql && echo '--- statement count (semicolons) ---' && grep -o ';' sol.sql | wc -l && echo '--- comment lines ---' && (grep -nE '(--|/\*)' sol.sql || echo NONE) && echo '--- re-verify output ---' && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/sol2.out && diff /tmp/ref.out /tmp/sol2.out && echo OUTPUT_MATCHES_REFERENCE && wc -l /tmp/sol2.out
